heading: Rule 7 — `realtime` requires `constspace`
text:
### Rule 7 — `realtime` requires `constspace` [LCAP.3.7]

`constspace` is the bounded-memory half of `realtime` ([LCSP.1.3]), and
`realtime: true` requires `constspace: true`, as a fundamental constraint
alongside those of [LCAP.3.8]. The compiler does not set `constspace` on the
author's behalf: a program with `realtime: true` and `constspace: false` is a
constraint violation ([LDIA.3.5.1]). `realtime` is the binding choice for every WCET/lifecycle
decision; `constspace` contributes the **alloc-free** property and the
unbounded-allocation gate ([LCAP.3.2]), and composes with the other settings
by intersection like any other ([LCAP.3.5]).
